runtime/quoted_printable#

The native layer under encoding/quoted_printable: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/quoted_printable: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable strict RFC 2045 quoted-printable boundary.

Public API#

native quoted_printable_encode#

native quoted_printable_encode(origin is @byte) is @byte

origin quoted-printable (RFC 2045).

native quoted_printable_invalid_offset#

native quoted_printable_invalid_offset(origin is @byte) is int

Where origin stops being quoted-printable, or -1.

native quoted_printable_decode#

native quoted_printable_decode(origin is @byte) is @byte

The bytes of quoted-printable origin.
